name: systeme.io
description: An all-in-one marketing platform and funnel builder for creating sales funnels, email campaigns, websites, and managing contacts.

evidence.claim: Systeme.io exposes a public REST API documented at developer.systeme.io/reference/api
API keys are generated in account settings under MCP & API keys
API covers contacts, tags, custom fields, newsletters, campaigns, and funnels
Clean REST API with API-key auth, webhooks, available even on free plan

notes: Systeme.io provides a clean, well-documented public REST API accessible via API keys generated right in the account settings. It supports contacts, tags, custom fields, newsletters, campaigns, and funnels.
